_Comment: Local debugging only: every group gets a generous budget so a breakpoint in a
backend service does not get cut off by the gateway. All three keys are listed
deliberately - before per-route policies existed, the single RequestTimeoutSeconds
override covered everything, and leaving the other two unset would have newly
capped interview/evaluation at the production 90s while debugging.
Container values are NOT here; the gateway runs as ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Compose,
which never loads this file and inherits appsettings.json instead.
